text:
sarah: FYI, small rollout (release/minor-2026) just hit canary and canary 5xx is spiking ~6% in eu-west-1. tagging oncall. anyone onstandby?
incident-bot: Pager: CanaryErrorRateHigh triggered for service inference-proxy. Threshold 3% exceeded. Paging @oncall-rosa. https://incidents.redwood/alerts/2311
oncall-rosa: oncall-rosa: ACK, taking it. looking at traces now. which commit is in the canary?
sarah: the canary contains PR #8421 (sha abc1234f) - small header change for batching. i can revert if we want to be safe.
devops-bot: Auto-fallback: traffic routing switched to previous canary baseline. Sessions draining (eta ~45s).
nick: i can push a hotpatch but revert is lower risk. if sarah can revert and trigger canary deploy, i'll monitor metrics and logs.
sarah: doing a quick revert now. command i'm about to run:
```
# revert locally and push
git checkout main
git revert --no-commit abc1234f
git commit -m "revert: PR #8421 - revert header change causing 5xx"
git push origin main
# trigger canary deploy
./scripts/ci/deploy --env canary --tag revert-8421
```
emma: i'll temp lower alert thresholds to 2% and watch dashboards (+enable expanded logging for inference-proxy).
devops-bot: CI: build/32145 started for tag revert-8421. deploy to canary queue accepted.
sarah: revert pushed and canary deploy kicked off. Monitoring logs and latency.
incident-bot: Canary metrics update: 5xx -> 4.1% (deploy in progress).
eva: quick check on customer impact: support queue shows 3 related tickets mentioning failures on batch endpoints, no large enterprise SLA pages yet. flagging for follow-up.
nick: can we get a short grep of the error trace? sarah, paste a sample log line if available.
sarah: sample 5xx trace snippet: `ERROR inference-proxy: handler.go:142 requestID=xx1 status=500 downstream=None header parsing failure`
emma: canary is now at 0.9% 5xx and service latency back to baseline. stabilizing for 5m.
devops-bot: Promote candidate: not triggered yet. waiting for 10m stable window.
oncall-rosa: good signal. if it holds for 10m we can promote. i'll stay on the thread until stable, then handoff to night oncall.
nick: i'll take over at 20:00 UTC if all good. please drop runbook + PR link.
sarah: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-errors  PR: https://gh.redwood/pr/8421  related logs: https://logs.redwood/query?sha=abc1234f
incident-bot: CanaryErrorRateHigh resolved: current 5xx 0.7%. Duration: 18m. Severity: P2. Owner: sarah.
oncall-rosa: thanks. i'll open a short postmortem and list follow-ups: stricter canary thresholds for header-parsing changes, add unit check in binary for header edgecases, consider auto-revert on >4% sustained 5xx.
emma: :thumbsup:
nick: ACK, taking over monitoring and will follow-up on postmortem tasks during handoff.
sarah: thanks all — closing thread once stable promoted to prod.
